failure_mode.summary: A1 exact SHA predates Shared Lab harness files, so current default Lab suites cannot execute this client SHA without conflating harness and code under test.
failure_mode.earliest_failure: _component_hash raises when suite component_globs match no files in the exact-SHA A1 worktree; suites can also reference test paths absent from that worktree.

required_integration_change.requirement: Decouple the versioned Lab harness from the exact target worktree while preserving the target commit SHA.
acceptance: Lab harness code/tests execute from a separately versioned Lab revision or immutable harness package.
Code under test is imported or invoked strictly from the requested exact-SHA target worktree.
Evidence records both target_sha and lab_harness_sha_or_hash.
Component hashes distinguish target-code hash from harness hash.
A client branch that predates Lab can run functional/causality suites without modifying the client SHA.
No result is labelled PASS when harness or target provenance is ambiguous.
